newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Great Central says has no Barrick bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Great Central says has no Barrick bid.

text.p: Australian gold miner Great Central Mines Ltd said on Wednesday it has not received a takeover offer from Canada's Barrick Gold Corp.
"Great Central Mines Ltd, in response to press speculation, advises that it has not received, nor is it aware of, a takeover bid from Barrick Gold Corporation," the company said.
Recent speculation that Barrick was readying a takeover bid for Great Central was earlier renewed by developments in the foreign exchange market.
Dealers said a large buy order for Australian dollars worth about A$450 million from a Canadian corporate saw the local currency surge around 1-1/2 Canadian cents offshore.
"The talk is it came from Barrick which needs the dollars to pay for Great Central," one trader told Reuters.
The Australian newspaper reported on Wednesday that Barrick was expected to launch a A$3.40 per share cash takeover bid for Great Central Mines as early as today.
The bid would value the Australian miner at A$863 million.
Great Central shares rose 12 cents on Tuesday, and were trading up a further 10 cents at A$2.80 at 10.25 a.m. (0025 GMT).
